candidates.name: Decibel usDCBL
candidates.reason: Decibel's May 2026 mainnet update states that its economic model is now live with usDCBL; current Decibel terms identify Bridge as issuer. This supersedes batch 038's earlier hold, which was based on the February launch note saying integration would occur in coming weeks. Full-layer review must still bound issuer affiliate, reserve composition, redemption, legal claim and exact token identity.

candidates.name: Gaia GUSD
candidates.reason: Existing reviewed candidate. Launch announcement establishes a distinct Bridge-powered Gaia stablecoin identity, but issuer legal entity and exact live deployment remain unresolved in reviewed primary material.
